# DogsBay XML — Authoring DITA

## Authoring DITA

- [Topics and maps](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/authoring/topics-and-maps.md): Write topics in the source or Author view, assemble them into maps, and edit map structure without breaking references.
- [Keys and reuse](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/authoring/keys-and-reuse.md): Resolve keys across a map, convert direct references to keys, and move shared content into reuse topics.
- [Conditional content](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/authoring/conditional-content.md): Profile content with conditions, filter it with DITAVAL, and keep the values under control with a subject scheme.
- [Metadata](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/authoring/metadata.md): Define required topic metadata, audit the project, and fill in missing fields.
